data.body: RP-03 retry-envelope parallel validation complete (2026-08-17); full note: .joe-janitor/rp03-retry-envelope-validation.md. No workflow was dispatched, no tracked/production file changed, and RP-04 was untouched. Historical Actions: 16 live Jira Cloud jobs from Aug 5-17 all passed (17 tests/job, 64.34-129.55s, median about 84.3s) with no logged Jira 429/5xx, Retry-After, or transport timeout. The matching 16 DC jobs were 5 pass/11 fail; failures were semantic/state/capability or local Git defects, not transient Jira transport. Run 31879125045 job 94999114642 passed 73 tests in 4444.49s after 99 Jira readiness probes; readiness/provisioning is a separate lifecycle protocol and must not consume the operation retry budget. No sampled outcome needed a fourth Jira call or more than 15s inline sleep, but this is weak negative evidence because current logs omit physical-attempt telemetry and silent SDK/ACLI retries. Required observability is now explicit: logical operation/postcondition, physical count, delay source/value, remaining call/sleep/deadline budgets, retry_not_before, scope, and terminal outcome. OSS comparison found no exact numeric consensus: defaults range from one call to 11 depending on write/controller/read-only workload. Consensus is finite retries, Retry-After/reset as a lower bound, exponential backoff+jitter without an authoritative delay, separation of physical replay from delayed logical/job retry, and deferral of long waits. Jira examples: pycontribs defaults to 4 hidden calls; atlassian-python-api default rate handling is 2 calls; GitLab sends foreground Jira requests once then retries a worker at 30s/5m/30m; Sentry separates foreground translation from 5 background retries; Airbyte uses 11 calls for GET-only ingestion; Mattermost/go-jira sends once. GitHub Octokit defaults to 4 total calls and 14s cumulative sleep; python-gitlab is more lenient for 429; Linear leaves retry to callers. Recommendation refined to maximum 3 total physical invocations across one atomic logical postcondition, 15s cumulative sleep, 2s then 4s fallback with nonnegative jitter, authoritative delay as lower bound with retry_not_before deferral, and one observe/replan cycle sharing the same budgets. Atomic means compound ticket updates are decomposed and never replayed wholesale. Current delta: generic 4-call/core wrapping is removed; Cloud nested worst-case 12 and DC measured 4/12/theoretical 16 fall to 3; ACLI usually remains at 3 but stops blind permanent/ambiguous replay; 60s Retry-After capping is intentionally reversed; DC SDK retries are disabled; typed deferral/scope replaces exception-class-dependent blast radius. Preserved: auth/TLS/permanent-4xx fast abort, ACLI reaping and write-timeout protection, 404 isolation, write-ahead/index-lag/keyless recovery, single-send operations without deterministic identity, exact partial success, and no fictional rollback. Envelope is pending maintainer approval.
